Name: TXT Lightstick for Json Assets
Author: MoonMoon27
Description:
This mod adds two weapons to use instead of the Galaxy Sword and Infinity Blade for any fellow MOAs out there!

[list]
[*]Version one of TXT's lightstick has the same stats as the Galaxy Sword and can be bought at the Casino for 10000 Casino Coins. It is intended to be obtained after the Galaxy Sword. If you play SVE, it will receive the same stat change that the Galaxy Sword does![/*]
[*]Version two of TXT's lightstick has the same stats as the Infinity Blade and can be bought at Qi's Gem Shop for 50 Qi Gems. It is intended to be obtained only after you have upgraded the Infinity Blade. Same as before, if you play SVE, the lightstick will still match the changed stats of the Infinity Blade![/*]
[/list]
I made these as separate weapons so that they did not conflict with weapon skin mods, and so that you can still have your Galaxy Sword and Infinity Blade but still have another cosmetic choice.

You will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url] to use this mod. Then, the folder for this mod only needs to be placed in the Stardew/Mods folder. I have not tested this on mobile. Please leave a comment if you experience errors !!

If anyone is interested in me making another group's lightstick, making alternative stats for these ones, or something like that, just leave a comment! If you would like to translate this mod, feel free ^^

Manifest.Name: TXT Lightstick
Manifest.Description: Adds TXT's lightsticks to Stardew. Ver. 1 and Ver. 2 work as the Galaxy Sword and Infinity Blade respectively. Stat change for those with SVE.
